description: This file defines the class PackagerImplementation and related nested classes, interfaces, and methods for a software package manager component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to package management, configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IPackager interface, managing package installation, configuration, notifications, and internal state.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class for JSON configuration parameters related to package management.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: Nested class for plugin-specific configuration, mainly system root path.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Implements IPackager::IPackageInfo, representing package metadata such as name, version, and architecture.

classes.name: InstallInfo
classes.description: Implements IPackager::IInstallationInfo, representing current installation status, progress, and errors.

classes.name: InstallationData
classes.description: Structure holding pointers to PackageInfo and InstallInfo objects for ongoing installation processes.

classes.name: InstallThread
classes.description: Worker thread class for handling package installation asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer for package events.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package manager with the provided service.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package with specified name, version, and architecture.
